<section id="volunteer" class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #FFFFFF; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div style="max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto;">
    <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">
      Volunteer With Us
    </h2>
    <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #0B1F3B; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"></div>

    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
      Our volunteers are the hands and feet of this ministry. Whether you have an hour a week or a season to give, there is a place for you in building the school and spreading the Word.
    </p>

    <!-- Volunteer areas grid -->
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1rem; margin: 2rem 0;">
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;">
        <strong style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0B1F3B;">✦ Share the School Campaign</strong>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">Tell your church, friends, and network about the campaign to build a Christian school in Juba.</p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;">
        <strong style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0B1F3B;">✦ Construction & Trades Expertise</strong>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">Advise on building, planning, or project management as Phase 1 — land, foundation, and first classrooms — takes shape.</p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;">
        <strong style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0B1F3B;">✦ Education Expertise</strong>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">Share curriculum, teaching, or school-administration experience to help shape a Christ-centered school.</p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;">
        <strong style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0B1F3B;">✦ Facebook Live Ministry</strong>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0.5rem 0 0;">Watch Evangelist Gai's live preaching, share the broadcasts, and invite others to tune in.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Volunteer Form -->
    <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem; margin-top: 2.5rem;">
      <h3 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.35rem; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600;">Express Your Interest</h3>
      <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">Tell us about yourself and how you'd like to serve. We'll be in touch soon.</p>

      <form name="volunteer" method="POST" data-netlify="true" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;">
        <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="volunteer" />

        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem;">
          <div>
            <label for="vol-name" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Full Name *</label>
            <input type="text" id="vol-name" name="name" required style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="vol-email" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Email *</label>
            <input type="email" id="vol-email" name="email" required style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem;">
          <div>
            <label for="vol-phone" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Phone</label>
            <input type="tel" id="vol-phone" name="phone" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="vol-interest" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Area of Interest *</label>
            <select id="vol-interest" name="interest" required style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
              <option value="">Select an area</option>
              <option value="share-campaign">Sharing the School Campaign</option>
              <option value="construction-expertise">Construction & Trades Expertise</option>
              <option value="education-expertise">Education Expertise</option>
              <option value="church-partnership">Church Partnership</option>
              <option value="facebook-live">Facebook Live Ministry</option>
              <option value="prayer">Prayer & Intercession</option>
              <option value="administration">Administration & Operations</option>
              <option value="other">Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="vol-message" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Tell Us About Yourself</label>
          <textarea id="vol-message" name="message" rows="4" placeholder="What draws you to this work? How would you like to contribute?" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 200ms ease;"></textarea>
        </div>

        <button type="submit" style="align-self: flex-start; background-color: #0B1F3B; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms ease; min-height: 48px;">
          Submit Volunteer Interest
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>

  <style>
    #volunteer input:focus,

      }
    }
  </style>
</section>

<section id="partner" class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #F7F6F2; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div style="max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto;">

      Partner With Us

      The school in Juba is being built in partnership with local churches, community leaders, and organizations on the ground. Here in the U.S., we welcome churches, organizations, and businesses who want to stand behind the campaign and the youth evangelism ministry.
    </p>

    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem;">

      <div style="background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem 1.5rem; border-left: 4px solid #0B1F3B;">

        </p>

      <!-- Nonprofits -->

        <h3 style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">Nonprofits & Organizations</h3>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.7;">

        <h3 style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">Businesses</h3>

<!-- PRAYER SECTION                                  -->

<section id="pray" class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #FFFFFF; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div style="max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto;">
    <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">
      Prayer & Intercession
    </h2>
    <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"></div>

    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 2rem;">
      Prayer is the foundation of everything we do. We invite you to join our prayer community — interceding for the school campaign, the ministry, and the people of South Sudan.
    </p>

    <!-- Current Prayer Focuses -->
    <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(11,31,59,0.05), rgba(212,160,23,0.06)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem; border-left: 4px solid #D4A017; margin-bottom: 2.5rem;">
      <h3 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600;">Current Prayer Focuses</h3>

      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem;">
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: flex-start;">
